signal_definition: Immediately after first ERC20 inbound token transaction block, which is self-signed for included candidates except any explicit verification gap; no recognition until block has completed (lookahead avoided)
exit_definition: Immediately after first ERC20 outward token transaction block; ignores subsequent wallet buys and sells and is NOT full historical wallet strategy
snapshot_positions: Post-block getReserves at signal_block+lag and first_out_block+lag; reject if either pair not deployed or reserves zero/unsupported; both token0/token1 and decimals must be retrieved and verified
fee_assumption: ZERO_FEE_OPTIMISTIC_BOUND; excludes pool fee, gas, failed tx, sandwich, nonce, delay to observe finality and MEV
formula: token_out = floor(Rtoken_buy * inputBNB / (Rbnb_buy + inputBNB)); bnb_out = floor(Rbnb_exit * token_out / (Rtoken_exit + token_out)); scenario BNB delta = bnb_out - inputBNB. Ignores trader perturbation of intermediate reserves, assumes reserves snapshots unaffected by follower; exploratory only.
denominations: All 8 pairs must be token/WBNB V2; require CA and WBNB token identities match, token decimals from metadata and reserves nonzero
outcomes: For every frozen row persist actual raw reserves, RPC error and rejection reason, output wei and net wei only if all inputs valid; no winner replacement, no threshold tuning, no expanding lags to make result better
pass_gate: NONE: V0 is exploratory and cannot authorize production, signals, Gmail, automation, or trading
